content:
TOMISLAV MESARIĆ
Butcher | Meat Counter Assistant
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Qualified butcher with experience in carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning and customer service across a family butcher shop and a busy market meat counter. Skilled in fresh sausage production, FIFO stock rotation and HACCP temperature and hygiene checks. Known for helpful advice on cuts and cooking, careful food handling and training apprentices.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb
2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Produce around 40 kg of fresh sausages per week in the busy season, including ćevapi, kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback; the ćevapi won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair.
- Rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, placing the oldest stock at the front.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily.
- Serve around 120 customers on Saturdays, advising on cuts, quantities and cooking times.
- Train two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting events, including ordering, butchering, seasoning and delivery. Completed orders for three weddings and around 10 family parties annually; largest order was four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding.
- Ran a six-week dry-ageing trial of beef ribs, recording temperature and weight loss; the shop now sells dry-aged rib by pre-order.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb
2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers, the counter and floor drain at closing.
- Wrote a one-page closing and cleaning checklist following a hygiene inspection remark; it remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb, 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown: beef, pork and lamb | Boning, trimming and portioning | Fresh sausage making | FIFO stock rotation | HACCP temperature and hygiene checks | Knife sharpening | Mincer and bandsaw operation | Customer service and product advice | Cash handling | Cleaning and sanitising equipment

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) | English (good) | German (basic)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear progression from Counter Assistant to Butcher, relevant quantified achievements, and excellent evidence of practical butchery, customer service, food safety, stock rotation, and apprentice training. The summary is targeted to the role, while the experience section gives credible operational detail such as carcass volumes, sausage production, customer numbers, temperature checks, and event orders. The document is professional and complete for this vacancy. Its main limitation is not a writing defect: the candidate has no supermarket self-service packaging experience and no forklift licence, but these gaps are not misrepresented.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses ATS-friendly headings, chronological employment history, standard text formatting, relevant job-title wording, and strong keywords including butcher, meat counter, carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning, customer service, FIFO, HACCP, temperature checks, hygiene, sausage making, cash handling, and cleaning and sanitising. The exact phrase "HACCP knowledge" is not used, although the certificate and practical HACCP-related duties clearly demonstrate it. Adding that exact supported phrase would provide a minor ATS improvement. There are no apparent tables, graphics, columns, or unsupported keyword additions likely to interfere with parsing.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document is an excellent match for the two must-have requirements: it shows completed butcher training, nine years of relevant butchery and meat-counter experience, and practical HACCP knowledge. It aligns closely with the role's duties through cutting, portioning, customer advice, FIFO rotation, temperature records, counter hygiene, and cash handling. The helpful product advice and cooking guidance also match FreshCart's emphasis on knowledgeable counter staff and its "Ask the counter" promise. The candidate's material shows a gap for the nice-to-have forklift licence. The original notes also show no experience with supermarket self-service packaging, tray sealers, or labelling scales; this is a role-experience gap rather than a CV defect and should not be presented as experience the candidate has.
critique.improvement_instructions: MINOR ATS ENHANCEMENT — In the Professional Summary section, revise the HACCP sentence to include the exact supported keyword "HACCP knowledge": change "Skilled in fresh sausage production, FIFO stock rotation and HACCP temperature and hygiene checks" to "Skilled in fresh sausage production, FIFO stock rotation and HACCP knowledge, including temperature and hygiene checks." This preserves the truthful evidence already present while matching the job description more directly.
critique.critical_issues:
Claims the sources (the candidate's own material; for the employer, the job ad and company research) do not support:
- "busy market meat counter"
- "Known for helpful advice"
- "careful food handling"

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) | English (good) | German (basic)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear headings, relevant experience, quantified results, and a professional tone. It presents an unusually strong match for a butcher/meat-counter role: completed butcher training, 9 years of relevant experience, carcass breakdown, customer advice, sausage production, FIFO rotation, temperature records, cleaning, cash handling, and apprentice training. The quantified details—such as 120 Saturday customers, weekly carcass volumes, 40 kg of sausage, and the 180-guest wedding order—make the experience credible and impactful. The CV is also consistent with the Original Candidate Information and does not appear to contain unsupported qualifications or experience.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses an ATS-friendly single-column structure with conventional section headings, standard date formatting, plain-text contact details, and keyword-rich skills. It includes the job description's strongest supported terms, including butcher training, meat counter, HACCP, fresh sausage production, FIFO stock rotation, temperature checks, customer service, portioning, boning, trimming, cleaning and sanitising, and cash handling. The document should have a high probability of passing both keyword-based ATS screening and AI screening. A minor enhancement would be to use the exact phrase "fresh meat" and make the counter-service context slightly more explicit in the experience bullets, although the current wording is already clear.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The alignment is excellent. The document shows both mandatory requirements: completed butcher training and more than 2 years of meat-counter experience, plus HACCP knowledge. It also strongly matches the practical duties of cutting, portioning, customer advice, FIFO rotation, and temperature records. The customer-service examples support FreshCart's emphasis on knowledgeable and helpful counter staff, while the cleaning, hygiene, and HACCP content supports its food-safety priorities. The candidate's experience in a family butcher shop and market stall is highly transferable, even though the material states that they have not worked in a supermarket and have not used tray-sealing or self-service labelling equipment. The candidate also does not hold a forklift licence; this is only a nice-to-have and is correctly not claimed in the CV. The CV does not show experience maintaining a stated 95% peak-hours stock level or packaging for self-service shelves, but these are role-experience gaps rather than defects in the document.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the Professional Summary, change "across a family butcher shop and a market meat counter" to "across a family butcher shop and a market meat counter, cutting and portioning fresh meat for customer orders". This adds the job description's "fresh meat" wording without claiming supermarket self-service packaging experience.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the Skills section, change "HACCP temperature and hygiene checks" to "HACCP temperature records and hygiene procedures" unless the candidate specifically completed formal hygiene checks. This wording is more precisely supported by the documented temperature logs, cleaning routines, HACCP certificate, and closing checklist.
